notes: Three front-ends co-exist on sciex.com: v3 Tailwind (51/73 sample pages; clientlib-site.min.css; body.stretch-text), legacy "globalpage" (15/73; clientlib-base/global; proxima-nova + teal/orange), and Edge Delivery blocks (3/73; /styles/styles.css + /blocks/*). This file describes the v3 system as the brand surface (it owns home, all hubs, products, applications, technology, about) and records the other two under type.subsystems / palette dropped / page-types.json designSystem.

Home h1 is text-bravo 52px/270 (white on photo); cross-page h1 is text-alfa 64px/270 (37 hero-text pages). Type ramp reported from the cross-page value; divergence kept in type.headingFamily.sizeLevels.

Palette occurrences use utility-class counts inside <main> across the 51 v3 pages (header/footer/megamenu stripped) because computed styles were probed on 3 pages only; computedArea1440 / computedElements give the 3-page computed evidence. Header+footer alone contribute ~28k tw-text-blue-700 uses across the crawl (megamenu), which would swamp any content signal.

Palette capped at 8; dropped colours listed in paletteDropped (grey-50 #f5f5f5, grey-300 #a1a1a1, overlay black, grey-700 dividers, blue-900 active, the legacy teal/orange family and the EDS #0072ce).
Border-radius: home mode and cross-page mode agree (4px on buttons only; imagery square). No divergence.
No shadows at rest anywhere on v3 pages except the account popover; the flat look is a real property of the site, not a capture gap.
media.cssBackgrounds is empty on all 73 records, so no background-motif system components exist; heroes use with object-fit cover.

The login-nudge tooltip seen in 63 screenshots is a WalkMe balloon (third party), styled in legacy teal #007da4 with an orange highlighter; the native login affordance is the account popover (.account-dropdown-content).
Megamenu images (63 per page under /megamenu/) are excluded from assets/media by instruction; 42 content images from the 3 archetype pages were saved (assets/media/_manifest.json).

Typekit (proxima-nova) files were re-fetched with descriptive names (proxima-nova-<weight>[-italic].<woff2|woff|otf>) because the kit serves them as /l /d /a; the intercepted copies were identical bytes.
Records carry no embedDominance field; embed-dominance detection skipped. YouTube iframes on 3 pages and 4 self-hosted mp4 <video> elements are below the fold.

products-consumables-lc-ms-performance-kits redirected to /products/consumables and duplicates that record; support-login and the 2 training pages captured the Danaher Auth0 login (external chrome, not sciex.com brand); about-us-career-opportunities captured jobs.danaher.com.

structure.behaviour: Alpine.js x-data (selectedSubItem) toggles panels on click; images 320×180 (63 per page in DOM, lazy)
